name: Yasashii Mahou no Tonaekata
source:
Even though Tsukasa lives in a world where magic is recognized, he still doubts its existence since he had not seen it with his own very eyes. One day, the magic club and science club at his school had an argument, ended up with a competition where the loser would have to disband their club. The magic club believes in magic which grants wishes, while the science club believes that one must gradually work towards realizing their wishes. Tsukasa thought that even though their methods were different, in the end it was all about fulfilling one’s dream. He was asked by his childhood friend Ibuki to help out the science club, but that’s when he met Mashiro who was a true magician.

[Fom [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/august-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
雖然司生活在一個魔法被認可的世界裡，但他仍然懷疑魔法的存在，因為他從未親眼見過。一天，學校的魔法社和科學社發生了爭論，最終演變成一場競賽——輸的一方必須解散社團。魔法社相信能實現願望的魔法，而科學社則認為必須腳踏實地地努力才能實現願望。司認為雖然方法不同，但最終都是為了實現夢想。他被青梅竹馬拜託去幫助科學社，但就在這時他遇到了真正的魔法師真白。
